labels.corroborated_by: on a listed item: the OTHER ingestion channels the same document (same canonical URL) arrived through — independent receipt, not a content judgment
labels.counts: whole-day observation counts by collection/doc_type, backfill included
labels.day_context: null on federal business days; on weekends/federal holidays an object {kind, name, note} explaining why the stream may be short
labels.duplicate_of: on a non-listed item: the package_id of the listed twin; the human pages show that one entry, marked corroborated — filter these out to match the human listing
labels.is_backfill: true = the publisher dates this item on another day (claimed_day); not part of this day's news
labels.items: ALL observed items including backfill — filter on is_backfill=false to match the human page's listing
labels.opening_verbatim: first ~240 chars of the official text, unedited
labels.summary_method: official = agency/GPO text; llm = model-generated, labeled
labels.tags: mechanical (branch, document type, agency); no model-generated item tags yet
